# Transform Your Home into an Immersive Icy Wonderland ❄️✨

**Welcome to Mixed Snow Worlds**, an auto-adaptive **Mixed Reality** game that transforms your home into an icy realm! Your entire environment, with all its objects, becomes part of a fully immersive free-roam MR and VR experience.
[media]

## **🔮 TRANSFORM YOUR SURROUNDINGS INTO A PLAYSPACE**

Our new 2Sync room scanner maps your room, then the icy world builds itself around your real walls and furniture. Scan a room once and reuse it in House Defender and Elven Arrows.

[media]

It's all up to you: Armed with a **trusty snow cannon** and a **special flashlight** that unveils the **hidden virtual world**, you set out to protect your home. 🏡✨ Adorable yet mischievous monsters pop through walls, eager to freeze everything with their chilly touch. 🧊

[media]
## **Why "Mixed Snow Worlds" Stands Out**
The game **adapts** to your home's layout. Move freely through your space and team up with a friend in the same room to fight side by side against the icy invasion. ❄️⚔️

###
## **Key Features:**
- **Auto-Adaptive Mixed Reality** transforms your living space into a virtual ice battleground with the power of the **2Sync SDK**.
- Seamlessly transition between **Mixed Reality and full immersion**.
- Defend against dimension-hopping enemies with your **snow cannon** and **flashlight**.
- **Worldwide leaderboard** for your high score.

## **More from 2Sync:** 

-  House Defender
-  The Last Galaxy
-  Elven Arrows

Find more: **games.2Sync.io**
